description: Fetch a URL and extract exactly the JSON you ask for. Pass a field `schema` (or `instructions`) and get a validated JSON object pulled from the page content. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

instructions.description: Plain-English extraction instructions (used if no schema).

schema.description: Map of field name → description of the value to extract.
